intro.en: Appliance wire and cable connect power, controls, motors, heaters, sensors and user interfaces inside equipment. The same appliance can contain cool control spaces, hot zones, wet areas, moving doors and serviceable modules, so one generic wire description is rarely enough.
intro.zh: 电器电线电缆连接设备内部的电源、控制器、电机、加热器、传感器与人机界面。同一台电器中可能同时存在低温控制区、高温区、潮湿区、活动门体和可维修模块，因此很少能用一种笼统线材覆盖全部位置。

knowledge.en: Internal appliance wiring, appliance wiring material (AWM), flexible cord and a completed appliance are different specification and certification scopes. A wire style or component recognition defines stated construction and conditions of use; it does not by itself approve the finished appliance or harness.
knowledge.zh: 电器内部配线、器具布线材料（AWM）、柔性电源线与完整电器属于不同的规范和认证边界。线材 Style 或元件认可只定义相应结构与使用条件，并不自动代表整机或成品线束已经获批。

notes.en: Provide destination market, governing product standard, appliance zone map, voltage and load, temperatures, moisture and chemicals, movement, conductor and insulation requirements, terminal system, entry protection, marking and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供目标市场、适用产品标准、电器分区图、电压与负载、温度、潮气和化学品、运动状态、导体与绝缘要求、端子系统、进线保护、印字及验证方案。

delivery.en: Release records the exact wire or cord designation and source, conductor and insulation construction, colour and marking, strip and termination dimensions, routing and protection details, traceability and the electrical, mechanical and environmental checks agreed for the assembly.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录准确线材或软线型号与来源、导体和绝缘结构、颜色印字、剥线与端接尺寸、布线和防护细节、追溯信息，以及组件约定的电气、机械与环境检查。

subtitle.en: Engineer every electrical path for its real zone inside the appliance
subtitle.zh: 根据电器内部真实区域设计每一条电气路径

lead.en: Separate internal wiring from the supply cord, then coordinate heat, moisture, movement, termination and product-level requirements.
lead.zh: 先区分内部配线与电源软线，再协同处理热、潮气、运动、端接与整机层级要求。

title.en: Internal wiring, flexible cord and the complete appliance are different approval boundaries
title.zh: 内部配线、柔性软线与完整电器属于不同批准边界

copy.en: Internal leads may connect a control board, switch, motor, compressor, heater or sensor, while a flexible supply cord crosses the equipment boundary and is exposed to handling and strain. UL 758 AWM, UL 62 flexible cord, IEC 60227 PVC cable and IEC 60245 rubber-insulated cable address different product constructions and scopes. The project drawing should identify the exact wire or cord, intended use and market requirement instead of treating every appliance cable as one family.
copy.zh: 内部引线可连接控制板、开关、电机、压缩机、加热器或传感器；柔性电源线则跨越设备边界，并承受日常抓取与拉扯。UL 758 AWM、UL 62 柔性软线、IEC 60227 聚氯乙烯绝缘电缆与 IEC 60245 橡胶绝缘电缆分别对应不同产品结构和范围。项目图纸应明确具体线材或软线、预期用途与市场要求，不能把所有电器用线视为同一系列。

title.en: An AWM style number is a construction and use condition, not a universal quality grade
title.zh: AWM Style 是结构与使用条件，不是通用质量等级

copy.en: An Appliance Wiring Material style can define conductor range, insulation material and thickness, voltage, temperature and flame or optional resistance properties. Two styles that look similar may have different permissible uses. Procurement therefore needs the exact style, manufacturer file or accepted equivalent criteria, printing and conditions of acceptability. A familiar UL mark or temperature number alone is not enough to approve a substitution.
copy.zh: 器具布线材料 Style 可以规定导体范围、绝缘材料与厚度、电压、温度、阻燃以及可选耐受性能。外观相似的两个 Style 可能具有不同允许用途，因此采购审核需要准确 Style、制造商档案或已确认的等效条件、印字及使用限制。仅凭熟悉的 UL 标识或温度数字不足以批准替代。

title.en: Heat must be mapped from the heater, motor, compressor and enclosure
title.zh: 热区要从加热器、电机、压缩机与外壳逐点绘制

copy.en: An oven lead near an element, a compressor terminal inside a refrigerator and a motor winding connection do not share one thermal profile. Continuous ambient temperature, short peaks, conductor self-heating, ventilation and repeated heating cycles all matter. Silicone, fluoropolymer, cross-linked or PVC constructions should be selected from the actual requirement and approved component system, not from a generic high-temperature description.
copy.zh: 靠近加热元件的烤箱引线、冰箱压缩机端子和电机绕组连接并不共享同一温度谱。持续环境温度、短时峰值、导体自发热、通风条件与反复热循环都需要考虑。硅橡胶、氟聚合物、交联材料或 PVC 结构应依据真实要求和获批元件体系选择，而不是依据笼统的“耐高温”描述。

title.en: Conductor size follows load, duty, bundle and voltage-drop limits
title.zh: 导体规格应跟随负载、占空比、成束与压降限制

copy.en: Heaters and motors can create steady current, start-up current or cycling loads. Route length, terminal resistance, enclosure temperature and bundling influence delivered voltage and conductor temperature. Fine stranding improves handling in some assemblies but does not independently establish current capacity. Engineering should calculate the circuit, then confirm conductor resistance, terminal range and insulation outside diameter as a compatible system.
copy.zh: 加热器与电机会形成持续电流、启动电流或周期性负载。路径长度、端子电阻、外壳温度和成束状态都会影响负载端电压与导体温升。细绞导体在部分装配中更易操作，但不能单独证明载流能力。工程应先计算回路，再把导体电阻、端子适用范围和绝缘外径作为兼容系统共同确认。

title.en: Steam, condensate, detergent and oil create different material questions
title.zh: 蒸汽、冷凝水、清洁剂与油污提出不同材料问题

copy.en: A washing machine, dishwasher, coffee machine and HVAC unit expose wiring to different liquids, vapours, cleaning chemicals and contamination. Exposure must be defined by substance, concentration, temperature, duration and repetition. Routing, drip loops, grommets, sleeves and sealed interfaces can be as important as the base insulation. A wet-area claim should never be inferred from colour, softness or cable appearance.
copy.zh: 洗衣机、洗碗机、咖啡机与暖通设备会让配线接触不同液体、蒸汽、清洁化学品和污染物。介质暴露必须由物质、浓度、温度、持续时间与重复次数定义。布线路径、滴水弯、护线圈、套管与密封接口的重要性可能与基础绝缘相同，不能从颜色、柔软度或线缆外观推断湿区适用性。

title.en: Doors, pumps, fans and service modules need controlled movement and access
title.zh: 门体、泵、风机与维修模块需要受控运动和可接近性

copy.en: A door hinge, sliding drawer, oscillating fan or removable pump creates repeated movement at specific points. Bend location, radius, torsion, clamp spacing, free length and connector support should be defined from the mechanism. Service loops must permit removal without rubbing sharp sheet metal or pulling terminals. A flexible-feeling cable is not evidence of a validated flex life.
copy.zh: 门铰链、滑动抽屉、摆动风机或可拆泵体会在特定位置产生重复运动。弯折位置、半径、扭转、夹持间距、自由长度与连接器支撑都应从机构出发定义。维修余量应允许拆卸，同时避免摩擦锋利钣金或拉扯端子；手感柔软并不能证明已经验证弯折寿命。

title.en: Terminal, housing, grommet and strain relief form one interface
title.zh: 端子、壳体、护线圈与应力消除共同形成接口

copy.en: Open-barrel terminals, quick-connect receptacles, ring terminals, board connectors and splice systems each impose a conductor and insulation range. At an appliance entry, the cord anchor or molded strain relief must control pull and flex before the force reaches electrical terminations. Sharp edges require a defined bushing or grommet. Strip length, crimp geometry, insertion, retention and routing are controlled features, not cosmetic details.
copy.zh: 开口式端子、快接插簧、环形端子、板端连接器与接点系统分别限定导体和绝缘范围。电器进线处的压线板或成型应力消除应在拉力与弯折到达电气端接前进行控制，锋利边缘则需要明确护套或护线圈。剥线长度、压接几何、插入、保持与布线都是受控特征，不是外观细节。

title.en: Component recognition does not replace finished-harness and appliance validation
title.zh: 元件认可不能替代成品线束与整机验证

copy.en: Incoming wire identity, dimensions, marking and traceability establish material control. Cut, strip, crimp and insertion checks establish workmanship control. The finished harness then needs continuity and project-defined checks such as dielectric strength, insulation resistance, earth continuity, temperature rise, pull, flex, moisture or functional testing. The final appliance manufacturer determines which product-level standard and evidence apply.
copy.zh: 来料线材身份、尺寸、印字与追溯建立物料控制；裁线、剥线、压接和插入检查建立工艺控制。成品线束还需进行导通，以及项目规定的耐压、绝缘电阻、接地连续性、温升、拉力、弯折、潮湿或功能测试。最终适用的整机标准与证据由电器制造商及项目要求确定。

inputs.en: Destination market and applicable appliance, wire or cord standard
inputs.zh: 目标市场及适用整机、线材或软线标准

inputs.en: Appliance zone map with heat, moisture, chemicals and moving points
inputs.zh: 标出热、潮气、化学品与运动点的电器分区图

inputs.en: Voltage, current, duty, route length and protective device
inputs.zh: 电压、电流、占空比、路径长度与保护装置

inputs.en: Exact AWM style, cord designation, wire size, colour and marking
inputs.zh: 准确 AWM Style、软线型号、线径、颜色与印字

inputs.en: Terminal, housing, splice, grommet and strain-relief references
inputs.zh: 端子、壳体、接点、护线圈与应力消除资料

inputs.en: Drawing, sample, quantity, acceptance limits and test plan
inputs.zh: 图纸、样品、数量、验收限值与测试方案

q.en: Is AWM the same as a flexible appliance supply cord?
q.zh: AWM 等同于电器柔性电源线吗？

a.en: No. They belong to different product categories and use conditions. The exact equipment boundary, market and governing standard must be identified.
a.zh: 不等同。二者属于不同产品类别和使用条件，必须明确设备边界、目标市场与适用标准。

q.en: Can the same wire be used beside a heater and inside a cool control compartment?
q.zh: 加热器旁与低温控制仓可以使用同一种线吗？

a.en: Only after the actual temperature, load, insulation system, routing and product requirements are reviewed. Location-specific requirements can differ inside one appliance.
a.zh: 只有在审核真实温度、负载、绝缘体系、布线与整机要求后才能确定；同一电器内部的区域要求可能不同。

q.en: Does a higher temperature rating automatically make a wire suitable?
q.zh: 温度等级更高就一定更适用吗？

a.en: No. Voltage, conductor, flexibility, chemical exposure, terminal compatibility, flame requirements and approved use conditions still matter.
a.zh: 不一定。电压、导体、柔性、介质、端子兼容、阻燃要求与获批使用条件仍需匹配。

q.en: Can an existing appliance harness be reproduced from a sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有电器线束样品复刻吗？

a.en: A sample can establish geometry and help identify components, but circuit function, ratings, approved materials, pinout and acceptance criteria still require customer confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可用于整理几何并辅助识别元件，但回路功能、额定值、获批材料、针脚与验收标准仍需客户确认。

q.en: What changes require renewed engineering review?
q.zh: 哪些变更需要重新工程审核？

a.en: Changes to wire style or source, conductor, insulation, terminal, tooling, strain relief, routing, heat source, load or validation requirement can affect the released system.
a.zh: 线材 Style 或来源、导体、绝缘、端子、模具、应力消除、布线、热源、负载或验证要求的变化，都可能影响已放行系统。

q.en: Can Super Smile claim the finished appliance is certified?
q.zh: 超斯迈尔可以宣称完整电器已经认证吗？

a.en: Only the responsible certification body and appliance manufacturer can determine product-level certification. We manufacture and document the cable assembly to the confirmed project requirements.
a.zh: 整机层级认证只能由相应认证机构和电器制造商确定；我们依据已确认的项目要求制造并记录电缆组件。
